game.title: The Evil Within
game.blurb: Third-person survival horror game from Tango Gameworks, published by Bethesda Softworks, released 2014-10-12. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters follow the story chapters and add-ons named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Story milestones, all hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Chapter Feats: Chapters 2 to 7
chapters.summary: Optional feats the achievements tie to Chapters 2 to 7, such as the hospice vision and the rising water.

chapters.title: Chapter Feats: Chapters 8 to 14
chapters.summary: Optional feats for Chapters 8, 10, 12 and 14, such as the echoing cave, the bus and the generator panel.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Special Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing on Casual, Survival, Nightmare and AKUMU, under five hours, and without green gel upgrades.

chapters.title: Upgrades and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Every collectable, the save room lockers, upgrading Sebastian, the weapons and the Stock menu.

chapters.title: Combat and Stealth
chapters.summary: Kill counts, sneak kills, matches, torches, melee, bottles and Agony Bolts.

chapters.title: The Assignment
chapters.summary: The add-on's chapter feats, Research Documents, Personnel Files, the hidden letter and KURAYAMI Mode.

chapters.title: The Consequence
chapters.summary: The add-on's hotel feats, Ruvik, Research Documents, Personnel Files, the hidden letter and KURAYAMI Mode.

chapters.title: Later Hidden Block
chapters.summary: Ten hidden achievements at the end of the Steam list. They may belong to The Executioner, the third add-on RAWG lists, but the data does not say. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 268050)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/The_Evil_Within
Fandom (theevilwithin.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://theevilwithin.fandom.com/wiki/The_Evil_Within
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3554). Steam app 268050 ("The Evil Within") was used. StrategyWiki has no page under "The Evil Within", "Evil Within" or "PsychoBreak". theevilwithin.fandom.com answers the API under "The Evil Within" with about 77 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 23 of 71 Steam achievements are hidden. ach_0 to ach_7 (49% down to 27%) look like story milestones and sit in the main story chapter. RAWG lists three add-ons: The Assignment, The Consequence and The Executioner. ach_41 to ach_51 form the block whose descriptions name The Assignment, and ach_52 to ach_60 the block naming The Consequence; the add-on chapter numbers in those descriptions (Ch. 1, 2 and 4) are the add-ons' own, so those achievements, including the hidden ones in each block (ach_45, 46, 51, 55 and 56), were placed by block. ach_61 to ach_70 are all hidden and come after; they are put in a chapter that may be The Executioner, a guess by list position only. The base-game chapter feats name Chapters 2 to 8, 10, 12 and 14.
